entries.name: squeeze_momentum
entries.core_idea: TTM-style squeeze momentum; #983 froze entry and swept close stacks.
entries.failure_reason: 25-stack close sweep did not cut -58.5% DD without losing the +47.9pt vs-B&H edge.
entries.lesson: DD is regime exposure not an exit-stack problem; persistent long/flat entries re-enter next bar after stop-out (fee churn); holding-structure changes must be re-run on the continuous audit window.

entries.name: ichimoku_cloud
entries.core_idea: Ichimoku cloud; #997 M3 exit-quality knobs on frozen entry.
entries.failure_reason: M3 knobs fail OOS on every tried stop/time/zscore combo; late giveback dominates.
entries.lesson: Exit-quality knobs did not rescue ichimoku OOS; do not retune the same exits expecting a pass.
